data.markdown: **Investigate potential DNS-based C2 activity on host WS-MKT-0077**Host WS-MKT-0077 (10.20.22.41, user s.novak) issued 63 DNS queries to cdn-metrics-sync.example-analytics.net, a domain registered four days ago with no proxy category. This volume of requests to a newly registered resource warrants immediate investigation to determine if legitimate analytics traffic or malicious communication is occurring.- Threat intel scores the domain as suspicious (60) with tags for newly-registered and DGA-like characteristics, supporting the risk assessment.- Historical data shows one related alert for low-reputation domain queries on this same host, with zero prior true or false positives recorded.- Activity maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1071.004 (Application Layer Protocol: DNS) and T1568.002 (Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms).Recommendation is to investigate at P3 priority due to high confidence in the suspicious indicators and behavioral pattern. Next actions include isolating WS-MKT-0077, analyzing DNS query payloads for encoded data, reviewing s.novak’s recent activity, and validating whether example-analytics.net is an authorized vendor.
